items.relevant_quotes: Section 6.6; Exhibit G (G3A) PASS-01 to PASS-04
items.rationale: Contract requires documented password standard, length/strength, no default/compromised passwords, secure storage, lockout, no sharing, vaulting, break-glass rotation.

items.relevant_quotes: Sections 9.1-9.3; Exhibit G ASSET-01 to ASSET-03
items.rationale: Contract requires in-scope asset inventory, minimum fields, quarterly review, secure configuration baselines, prohibition of insecure defaults.
Contract requires security awareness training on hire and annually, and background screening to the extent permitted by law with policy and attestation.
Contract requires TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 where feasible) for Company-to-Service, admin pathways, and subprocessor transfers, with certificate management.

items.relevant_quotes: Sections 6.7, 8.2; Exhibit G NET-01 to NET-03
items.rationale: Contract specifies SAML SSO, OAuth for APIs, MFA for privileged/production, bastion/secure gateway with session logging, RBAC.
